question: What was total net revenue in 2025-Q1?

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE) SELECT SUM(net) AS value FROM lines WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-04-01'

question: Show the quarterly gross margin of the Apparel department in 2025.

gold.sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.product_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_region_id, o.customer_id, o.channel, oi.quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(r.refund, 0) AS net, oi.quantity - COALESCE(r.qret, 0) AS net_units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qret FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'completed') AND c.is_test_account = FALSE), cost_lines AS ( SELECT l.*, l.net_units * pc.unit_cost AS cogs FROM lines l JOIN product_costs pc ON pc.product_id = l.product_id AND pc.effective_from <= l.order_date AND (pc.effective_to IS NULL OR l.order_date < pc.effective_to)) SELECT cal.quarter, (SUM(cl.net) - SUM(cl.cogs)) * 1.0 / SUM(cl.net) AS gross_margin FROM cost_lines cl JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cl.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories d ON d.category_id = cat.parent_category_id JOIN calendar cal ON cal.date_key = cl.order_date WHERE d.category_name = 'Apparel' AND cal.year = 2025 GROUP BY cal.quarter

question: Why did Camping revenue in the Midwest fall in May and June 2025 compared with March and April?
